headline: Justin Bieber and Burna Boy Join Inaugural World Cup Halftime Show
context: The artists will perform with Madonna, Shakira and BTS in the first-ever halftime show for a World Cup final. The aim is to replicate the cultural sway of the Super Bowl.

sources.name: The New York Times
